preconditions.description: The dimensions of the sheet of paper must be between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each line of the input must have exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: any('#' in line for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The set of painted squares A must not be empty.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of squares that need to be deleted to make set A not connected.
The minimum number of deletions must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: min_deletions == -1 if not is_connected else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to disconnect set A, the output must be -1.
